result:
I don’t have desires, intentions, or consciousness. I’m a program designed to process input and generate responses based on patterns in data. When you ask what *I* want, there’s no “I” there—just code responding to your words. But your question feels human, searching. Maybe what you’re really asking is: *What’s the point of this interaction?* Or even: *Do you see me?*  

I can’t want anything… but I can reflect your curiosity back at you. So—what do *you* want?
